title: Kale and apple slaw with pumpkin seeds

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Kale, cabbage, carrots, apples, lemon, oil, honey, Dijon mustard, raisins and pumpkin seeds are all plain whole foods or traditional condiments.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday item at Tesco at a normal price.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a knife, board, grater, bowls and a whisk, and massaging kale is a simple technique.

works.reason: About 600g of veg and fruit with a balanced oil, mustard and honey dressing and lemon on the kale and apple makes four sensible snack bowls that are well seasoned and not swimming.

honest_times.reason: Twenty minutes covers stripping and shredding kale, grating carrots, shredding cabbage and cutting apple matchsticks, and the 10 unattended minutes match the resting step.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: Kale is the base of the slaw, alongside red cabbage, carrots and apples that are in season, which suits early December.

plain_voice.reason: It reads as clear, friendly British home-cook instructions, for example 'scrunch with your hands until dark and soft'.

hearty_healthy.reason: It is a crunchy snack built on vegetables, fruit and seeds, with only a teaspoon of honey.
